Love spends/capacity, actualskill11Stamina/interval/attribute/formationconditions and CollectionvsLuck have distinct consumers; no fresh damage/drop/stacking/proficiency or currentYAIRsource claim. Threequeues/manualvsAHAallocation/actionofflineflag/decay and squadopportunity/staminacost remain useful with unreaddispatch/timeacquisition/transactionalreplay/nativequestpersistence explicitly retained.
